narrative: KVP36-1646D-0137 hard faulted and would not restart. Fault log pointed at the DC bus. Opened the cabinet and found the DC bus capacitor bank had failed, one can visibly bulged. Replaced the capacitor from site spares. Verified DC bus voltage at 1042 V on restart, within the expected band. Unit has run through to end of shift with no recurrence. Ruled out a gate driver issue, those tested fine. This unit is a 2016 build and this is the first fault I have seen on it.
